projection.type: equirectangular (global simple cylindrical), planetocentric latitude and east longitude on the 1737.4 km sphere
projection.page_statement: "The map is centered on 0° longitude." (colour maps and displacement map)
projection.convention: Column 0 left edge = 180° W (-180°), image centre = 0°, right edge = 180° E; east longitude increases to the right. Row 0 top edge = 90° N; north is up. Texel (col, row) centre: lon = -180 + (col + 0.5) * 360 / width, lat = 90 - (row + 0.5) * 180 / height.
projection.verified: ldem_4_uint.tif: minimum -8878.5 m at 70.4° S 172.4° W (Antoniadi crater, South Pole-Aitken basin) and maximum +10504 m at 5.4° N 158.6° W (Selenean summit); near-side mean elevation -1.0 km vs far side -0.04 km; Mare Crisium floor (17° N, 59° E) -3.6 km. lroc_color_2k.jpg: near-side mean 0.708 vs far side 0.754 (maria on the near side); Tycho (43.3° S, 11.2° W) 0.918 vs 0.756 at the east-west mirror point; the FW-MOON-04 contact sheet places Mare Imbrium NW, Mare Crisium at the east (right) limb and Tycho's rays south. Evidence: docs/research/field-world/FW-MOON-04/README.md.

files.title: 2025 LROC colour map, 2048x1024 JPEG
files.author: Ernie Wright (USRA) for NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, from LROC WAC data (Arizona State University)
files.license: NASA media; credit "NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio" (see collection)

image.format: JPEG baseline, 4:4:4, embedded ICC profile sRGB IEC61966-2.1

files.content: Natural-colour Hapke-normalised WAC mosaic (base colour without lighting), gamma corrected, white balanced and range adjusted by SVS; not absolute albedo.

files.title: LOLA displacement map, 4 pixels per degree, unsigned 16-bit TIFF
files.author: Ernie Wright (USRA) for NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, from LRO LOLA gridded data (spring 2019 products)
files.license: NASA media; credit "NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio" (see collection)

image.format: TIFF, uncompressed strips, little-endian, one 16-bit unsigned sample (IDL 8.7.2)

files.encoding: elevation_m = (value - 20000) * 0.5 relative to the 1737.4 km reference sphere. Page: LOLA publishes signed 16-bit half-metres relative to 1737.4 km; "For the unsigned 16-bit TIFFs, the source data was offset by +20,000 (10 km) so that all of the values are positive."
files.selection: Chosen over ldem_4.tif (float km, same grid, 4.0 MB) because it is half the size, holds the identical half-metre data and Pillow reads it natively.
